title: raphanus maritimus subsp. littoralis
intro: Raphanus maritimus subsp. littoralis, commonly known as Sea Radish or Beach Radish, is a subspecies of the Raphanus maritimus plant, native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, making it a sought-after herb in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Raphanus maritimus subsp. littoralis are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
